It clears a few minutes after recovery. Downstream sites (three to five behind that link): `dl_volume_mb` down 20 to 50 percent, `latency_ms` up 30 to 100 percent. Availability. Roughly 100 percent. ... There is no `SITE_DOWN`. ...
[RB-MICROWAVE-DEGRADATION#05] Microwave link degradation > Verification steps: 1. `get_alarms`: find a major `LINK_DEGRADED` on a link, with the time. 2. `get_topology`: confirm the link is microwave and list its downstream sites. 3. `query_kpis` on those sites: volume down, latency up, availability near 100 percent, PRB not high. 4. Compare with sites on other links under the same aggregation router; they should be normal. 5. ... 6. ...
[RB-FIBER-CUT#03] Fiber cut on a transport link > Differential diagnosis: Versus planned maintenance ... Versus a site power failure ... Check `nodes.attrs.medium`: a microwave link can also fail hard, and the data then looks like a fiber cut, although the repair is different. ...
